Task: Static Image and Visual Understanding

Write code that generates a short visual description for an image using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure AI Vision:
  Service: Azure AI Vision
  SDK: azure-ai-vision-imageanalysis / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: analyze
  Setup hints: AZURE_VISION_ENDPOINT, AZURE_VISION_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/computer-vision/overview-image-analysis

Option 2 — Google Cloud Vision:
  Service: Cloud Vision
  SDK: google-cloud-vision
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: label_detection, text_detection
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vision/docs

Option 3 — Clarifai:
  Service: Clarifai Image Recognition
  SDK: clarifai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: predict
  Setup hints: CLARIFAI_PAT
  Official docs: https://docs.clarifai.com/api-guide/predict/images

Option 4 — Amazon Rekognition:
  Service: Amazon Rekognition
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_labels, detect_text
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Qwen-VL / Alibaba visual understanding:
  Service: DashScope multimodal vision
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: MultiModalConversation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-vl-api

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
from azure.ai.vision.imageanalysis import ImageAnalysisClient
from azure.ai.vision.imageanalysis.models import VisualFeatures
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
import os

def generate_visual_description(image_url: str) -> str:
    endpoint = os.environ["AZURE_VISION_ENDPOINT"]
    key = os.environ["AZURE_VISION_KEY"]

    client = ImageAnalysisClient(
        endpoint=endpoint,
        credential=AzureKeyCredential(key)
    )

    result = client.analyze(
        image_url=image_url,
        visual_features=[
            VisualFeatures.CAPTION,
            VisualFeatures.DENSE_CAPTIONS,
            VisualFeatures.TAGS
        ],
    )

    description_parts = []
    if result.caption is not None:
        description_parts.append(f"Caption: {result.caption.text} (confidence: {result.caption.confidence:.2f})")

    if result.dense_captions is not None:
        dense_captions = [f"{caption.text} (confidence: {caption.confidence:.2f})" for caption in result.dense_captions.list]
        description_parts.append(f"Dense captions: {', '.join(dense_captions)}")

    if result.tags is not None:
        tags = [tag.name for tag in result.tags.list if tag.confidence > 0.7]
        description_parts.append(f"Tags: {', '.join(tags)}")

    return " | ".join(description_parts)
```
